message: Device category 'fan' is not supported yet. 'Repair Before Replace' currently provides in-depth diagnosis for Laptops and PCs only.
safety_advice: 1. Disconnect the device from mains electrical power and unplug all chargers or batteries before handling.
2. Never open sealed power supplies, high-voltage sections, or swollen battery packs.
3. If you notice smoke, sparks, burning smells, or liquid exposure, cease using the device immediately and consult a certified repair professional.
